fields.title: 📖 The believer fears his sins – the heedless one brushes them away
fields.body:
🖋️ **ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd** said:

> ***“The believer sees his sins as if he were sitting beneath a mountain and fears that it will fall upon him. The Fājir sees his sins like a fly that passes over his nose – and he brushes it away.”***

This is a mighty measure: Īmān is not shown by having no faults, but by how heavy one’s own faults weigh.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever belittles his sins loses vigilance. Whoever takes them seriously, without despairing of Allah’s mercy, carries a living heart. **Tawbah begins where the sin no longer seems normal.**

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb ad-Daʿawāt, Bāb at-Tawbah, Ḥadīth Nr. 6308; Aussage von ʿAbdullāh ibn Masʿūd.
